method:
This tab shows gambling ads only, in two study lanes that are never summed, as clickable slices (brand × lane × footage): panel — our own panel record: YouGov Pulse panelists with RealityMine passive traces, Oct–Nov 2024. Rows are creatives members actually saw, with member-reported exposures and in-window clicks, attributed per creative on X, Facebook and TikTok feeds. Same corpus as the cycle and daily-burden tabs; 2024 record, not current ads.
tiktok — live 2026 TikTok-side collection: top-ads census and sweep rows plus the append-only banked creative-id map (oembed/OCR/ASR lanes), deduped by creative id. Engagement figures are platform-reported aggregates captured at pull time; spend appears only from vendor lanes, in vendor estimate units — TikTok platform spend fields are unverified units, never converted.
Nothing lands here without passing one gate with published rules: the advertiser routes to a curated gambling brand, the creative's own copy names one, or an unknown sweep brand proves a gambling signal in its copy; context gates drop look-alikes (a person surnamed Boyles, the FanDuel Sports Network TV channel naming itself, Walk-&-Earn reward apps). Everything that fails the gate is counted and named in 'Gate exclusions' below — sweep cohorts drift, so this tab re-gates every row on every refresh instead of trusting lane membership.
Everything reads from an append-only evidence bank rebuilt each refresh — rotated sweep files can no longer delete evidence. The UK Google DSA archive and press-release lane stay banked for analysis but are not shown here. Absent brands have right now no record that passes the gate — absence stated, not hidden. Panel cards are what members reported seeing in 2024; they carry no footage, so their slices show records, exposures and clicks as aggregate numbers, never fake
cards.
OWNER SCOPE (2026-11-01): gambling here means WAGERING — a sportsbook, casino or bookmaker. Sweepstakes platforms, free-to-play social casinos, daily-fantasy operators and sports-media brands are measured in this corpus, counted and named in Gate exclusions — and never shown as gambling ads. An unknown sweep brand must quote a hard wagering phrase (sportsbook/casino/real-money/deposit-withdrawal/odds-to-a-mile terms) in its own copy; a media name (networks, news, magazines) needs an explicit play-call, else it is coverage of betting, not betting.
Cards are REAL creative footage only: a creative appears when its own .mp4 is banked on disk or already hosted in this site's creative directory (footage hosted by ANY build persists across lane rotations — nothing that was ever hosted can be deleted by a sweep rotation), or when a banked remote map carries a play URL plus poster frame. Records without a creative asset stay in the ledger and slice meta as counts — counted, not hidden, just never as cards. Creative facts from previous press builds (routing, engagement, hosted media) are re-merged from the press snapshots each rebuild and re-pass the same gate; history gets no free pass.
Spend: spend_est_usd = third-party calibrated tier-band estimates (piPlay 1000x-min-CPM model documented in the band rows) joined by creative id; vendor_spend_units stay in vendor units. Neither is a platform invoice. MediaRadar 360 — CU Boulder's licensed TV/radio/print/digital spend product (formerly Kantar Media Ad$pender / Vivvix) — has no export on this host yet: its only scripted route runs an interactive PIPL query on a Colab worker under the principal login (SSO + MFA), and no script here holds a MediaRadar credential.
Gate exclusions (2026 sweep lanes): 60091 row(s) were in the bank but are not gambling-ad evidence — 57734 rows — sweep row naming no curated brand, copy shows no gambling signal (app/game/consumer-goods cohort drift) (examples: 1102×@peacock, 905×@abcnews, 678×@primevideo, 626×@spotify, 570×@netflix); 2307 rows — sports-media/news brand reporting odds & picks — it sells coverage, not wagers (examples: 2203×@espn, 22×@post, 13×Illinois Media School, 9×Miami Media School, 9×shortmax TV); 18 rows — daily-fantasy platform (Yahoo Fantasy) — DFS contests, not a sportsbook/casino (examples: 9×@yahoofantasy, 9×Yahoo Fantasy); 11 rows — free-to-play sweepstakes/social-casino marker in its own copy (no purchase / coins only / free play) — not a wagering product (examples: Marvel Rivals, Mic Drop Workshop, carlie27635, casey_costi, emilyisaacs16); 9 rows — walk-&-earn / reward-app advertiser (Tripsoft), not a gambling product (examples: 8×Tripsoft Global Ltd.); 6 rows — FanDuel Sports Network — the TV channel naming itself; not a sportsbook/casino ad (examples: 3×@fanduelsportsnetwork, 3×FanDuel Sports Network); 3 rows — sweepstakes platform (Metawin) — sweepstakes entries, not wagers (examples: 3×Prada); 3 rows — person-name / follow-graph artifact of the token 'boyles' (no sportsbook context) (examples: ?, Sony Pictures, boyles). Those records stay banked for analysis.
Spend appears only from vendor lanes and third-party tier-band models; vendor_spend_units stay in vendor units (vendor windows, currency as reported) — neither is a platform invoice, and lane totals are never summed. Licensed MediaRadar-360 advertiser spend under the CU Boulder license is not yet exported locally; the scripted export runs via PI login.
spend_model: spend_est_usd: third-party calibrated tier-band estimates joined by creative id; vendor_spend_units: vendor lane, units as reported. Neither is an invoice.

trends.note: Google interest index 0-100 within each shown window (the API rescales per window; values are comparable within a series and across same-window series, never as dollars). The official API exposes at most ~12 months per call: national carries the fuller multi-year capture where collected, state lines are a rolling 365-day weekly window.

licensed_spend.source: MediaRadar-360 / Ad$pender (CU Boulder licensed export via vivvix_mta; scripted through PI login, data-state stamped by the vendor)
